strokes.text: Declares the complete, ordered list of placements in one scene or group.
On apply the provider removes every placement that is not in the list and puts the rest in the declared order.
A source that is also placed in another scene keeps its other placements.
Use exactly one of these per container, and none for a container whose contents people arrange by hand.
Destroying the resource ends the contract and leaves every placement where it is.

glazes.parent_kind: Container type, `scene` or `group`. Defaults to `scene`. Changing it replaces the resource.
glazes.scene_name: Name of the scene, or of the group when `parent_kind` is `group`, whose contents are declared. Changing it replaces the resource.
glazes.scene_uuid: UUID of the scene or group whose contents are declared. Changing it replaces the resource.
